decisions.base: 50 Base standard-size cards. TCDB indexes only two true RC: Hideki Irabu #45 and Jose Cruz Jr. #47.
decisions.oversized: 24 glossy oversized 8x10 and 24 Dufex oversized 8x10, distinct checklists with numbered subjects not aligned to base numbers.
decisions.collation: Historical packs contain five regular Base plus one glossy oversized and one Dufex oversized; 10 packs per box; two additional insert families V2 1:47 and Z-Team 1:99.
decisions.rarity: Z-Team numbered /1000. Oversized 8x10 parallels cannot be modeled as equivalent base-number parallel because their numbering and subjects differ.
decisions.exclusions: Oversized Dufex Samples, The Big Picture previews and standard Samples are promos, excluded from wax.
decisions.release: Unreleased pending oversized image display, 7-card pack slot and odds implementation, pricing and QA.
